🐉 HTTYD × Top Heroes! Share Your Collaboration
Moments & Win Figures — 500 Submissions Unlock
Rewards for Everyone!

The Dragon Riders have arrived in Top Heroes! 🐉
Let’s capture this epic collaboration!

Bring dragons and heroes, Berk and the world of Top
Heroes, together in your photos,
capture your unique collaboration moments, and get
ready for exciting rewards! 📸✨

⏰ Event Period: October 15–22, 2026

🎁 Grand Rewards
🏆 Ultimate Prize ×5 | Top Heroes Physical Hero
Figure
🎟️ Lucky Prize ×10 | USD 19.99 Gold Blocks
🎁 Community Rewards | More submissions, more
rewards for everyone!
100 Submissions → 🎁 200 Diamonds + 5
Recruitment Tickets
200 Submissions → 🎁 10 Silver Chests + 10
Universal 15-Min Speedups
500 Submissions → 🎁 4 Gold Chests + 10 Epic
Resource Choice Chests

📦 After the event ends, all unlocked rewards will be
distributed at once based on the final total number of
submissions!
📢 Rewards will be distributed in the form of gift
codes!
📢 Submissions from all platforms will be combined
for the final count.
📢 The Ultimate Prize and Lucky Prizes will be
awarded randomly, and each player can win only
once.

📸 How to Participate
① Real-Life Collaboration
Take a photo of DreamWorks How to Train Your
Dragon scenes or merchandise with Top Heroes
gameplay!
② In-Game Collaboration
Share a collaboration-themed Top Heroes screenshot
with a short caption to create your own crossover
moment!

📝 How to Submit
Post your entry in the comments of this post and
include your Server ID + In-Game Name to complete
your submission!
✨ Entries must include collaboration-related
elements.
🚫 Photo editing, hand-drawn artwork, AI-generated
images, and other forms of image modification are
not allowed.

This magical encounter has already begun.
Pick up your camera and capture your very own Top
Heroes × How to Train Your Dragon moment!
